reviews.review_description:
Irusu Cricket VR is a solid, visually sleek cricket game that delivers fast-paced, satisfying batting with precision. The customization options are impressive—from stadiums and bats to jerseys (with flocked numbers—names next, anyone?), every detail feels polished.
With multiple modes (quick play, challenge, career) and solid animations, it’s a great pick for both cricket fans and newcomers. The fast pace keeps matches engaging, making it easy to pick up and play. A home run for VR sports fans! ⚡

Generally considered the pinnacle of IRUSU CRICKET VR  on the Meta Store. It boasts hyper-realistic bowling (up to 96 mph), beautiful world-class stadiums, and deep in-match statistics (pitch maps, worm graphs). It is highly praised for being accessible to beginners but challenging enough for experts.

I thought it would be the second best cricket game....but unfortunately it's one of the worst cricket game that I have played....

Blindly trusted irusu...felt let down this time

developer_response.body: Hi agsagin, we are genuinely sorry to hear we let you down this time. We know you trust Irusu, and we want to deliver on that expectation. Since the game is in Early Access, we are actively looking to fix the exact issues you experienced. When you say we need to improve from 'left right center,' what specifically felt the most unpolished to you? Was it the batting controls, the bowling mechanics, specific bugs, or the graphics? Please let us know here or drop us a detailed email at support@irusu.co.in. Your feedback will directly shape our next update!

reviews.review_title: It has gully cricket Mode I liked it
reviews.review_description: The game effectively transitions from gully cricket to a standard cricket ground, culminating in a realistic stadium experience. The cricket visuals are impressive, and the overall gameplay is solid. While additional features would be welcome in future updates, the current offering provides satisfactory value for its price.
